title: Chapter 423: Old Friends Gather
content:
Chapter 423: Old Friends Gather

In the deserted city, Shi Tianzhi, who had just left the city lord's mansion, followed his memory and rushed towards a place in the city. After a while, he stopped in a somewhat remote tavern.

"Old man, come and have a pot of wine!"

The man was a little excited and his voice rang out from the tavern. Suddenly, the two old men were stunned at the same time and looked towards the door.

When he saw the person's face clearly, the old man Zui and the old man Broken Sword stood up at the same time, with surprise in his eyes.

"When you were old, why are you back?!"

The old man Zui couldn't believe it, widened his eyes and raised his lips.

Shi Tianzhi laughed and was about to say something, he suddenly noticed the old man Broken Sword beside Old Man Zui, "Hmm? Broken Sword, you, you are back too!"

Not only the old man Zui was surprised, but Shi Tianzhi was also very surprised when he saw the old man Broken Sword.

It has been a long time since the three of them got together.

The wrinkled old face of the old man Broken Sword was filled with smiles at this moment, "We mentioned you a few days ago, but I didn't expect that you will be back in a blink of an eye."

Shi Tianzhi still laughed loudly, but as he smiled, a sad look appeared on his face again.

When the old man and the other drunk, they were very puzzled, "When we were old, we haven't seen each other for a long time, shouldn't we be happy? Why are you so bitter?"

The old man Broken Sword also nodded and looked at Shi Tianzhi.

"well!"

Shi Tianzhi sighed heavily, walked to the table, and without caring about anything, picked up the wine pot in front of him and drank it all in one go.

The two of them looked at Shi Tianzhi's lips, picked up the handkerchief she carried with her and wiped her mouth, and couldn't help asking, "Old Shi, you're going to be so anxious, can you say it quickly?"

"Your Moji's personality has never changed at all after so many years."

The old man Broken Sword nodded, shook his head again, and he was also a little impatient.

"You don't know anything."

Shi Tianzhi opened his mouth and wanted to speak, but suddenly he didn't know where to start.

After pondering for a moment, Shi Tianzhi asked directly: "I was enjoying the rest of my life in Tianxuan Continent. Do you know how I came back?"

Upon hearing this, the old man drunk and the old man Broken Sword looked at each other, then shook his head, "I don't know."

Shi Tianzhi looked around and looked around, a little cautious.

Seeing this, the old man Zui quickly dismissed the remaining guests, ignored their dissatisfaction and closed the door early.

It was not until the old man drunk told them that the guests left today's free wine list.

After the doors and windows in the tavern were closed and no one eavesdropped, Shi Tianzhi said seriously: "I met the city lord in Tianxuan Continent."

Lord, Lu Daosheng!

"What!"

The old man drunk couldn't help but exclaim, while the old man Broken Sword beside him frowned.

"How could the city lord appear in Tianxuan Continent?!"

The old man Zui was shocked and suspicious. In his eyes, the city lord Lu Daosheng was unfathomable and had great strength, so how could he be there?

"When you are old, don't you see the wrong person by presbyopia."

When Shi Tianzhi heard the old man Zui said, he was speechless, "I am not as confused as Broken Sword, how could I make such a mistake?"

The old man Broken Sword next to him suddenly blew his nose and stared at him, "Don't go too far, I'm still here!"

Seeing the old man Broken Sword like this, Shi Tianzhi waved his hand and said, "I'm not kidding."

The old man Zui was impatient and continued to ask: "Tell me quickly, why did the city lord appear in the Tianxuan World, and how did you come back?"

"Wait, I understand. The city lord suddenly appeared in the Tianxuan Continent, and you suddenly came back. It must be because the city lord saw you breaking the rules and was afraid that you would hurt the Tianxuan Continent, so he sent you back."

Before Shi Tianzhi could answer, the old man Zui was already full of imagination.

Shi Tianzhi twitched his mouth and shook his head and said, "No, no."

"It was the city lord who encountered some trouble, so he went back to Tianxuan Continent, yes, relax."

"Then the city lord told me that the Chaos Realm would be invaded by a great enemy, so he sent me back to contribute a little to the deserted city."

Shi Tianzhi slowly told him, but the old man drunk and the old man Broken Sword still frowned tightly.

The old man Zui said suspiciously: "You mentioned that the Chaos Realm encountered a great enemy invasion. I already know this. It's nothing. I have encountered few enemies along the way in the deserted city? It's not solved any time."

"It's just that you said the city lord is in some trouble. I want to know what trouble can a person like the city lord encounter?"

The old man Zui was not concerned at all with the invasion of the great enemy, but was incredible when he heard that Lu Daosheng was in trouble.

The old man Broken Sword on the side also agreed. If even the city lord could have trouble, how much trouble would it be.

The world is destroyed?

The old man Broken Sword picked up the wine glass and drank it gently, suppressing his breath.

At this time, Shi Tianzhi slowly exhaled a breath of turbid air and said softly: "The city lord told me that the world is going to be destroyed."

"Puff~"

The old man Broken Sword sipped the old wine with his sour tone and sprayed it on the drunk old man's face without leaving any of it.

The old man Zui wiped his face, ignored the old man Broken Sword, stared at Shi Tianzhi and asked, "What did you say? The world is going to be destroyed!"

Fortunately, the sound insulation effect of this tavern is very significant, otherwise it will inevitably cause unnecessary panic if it is heard by a person with intention.

But at this time, the old man drunk was a little buzzing.

He was simply incredible.

The old man Broken Sword was coughing violently at the moment, and choked by the old wine. He had not yet reacted, but after he reacted, he was also staring at Shi Tianzhi. His eyes, which were usually a little turbid, were as bright as light. .

Shi Tianzhi was a little furrowed when he was staring at by these two old guys, but he still spread his hands and said, "There is no lies in what I say. All of this was told by the city lord in person."

Silence, you fell into a long silence.

The old man drunk and the old man Broken Sword looked at each other, and there was no more surprise in his eyes as early as the beginning, but instead was replaced by a touch of sorrow.

Seeing this, Shi Tianzhi just sighed softly, and he understood the two of them.

Anyone who suddenly hears that the world is about to be destroyed can directly accept it.

Even a person like the city lord is still confused?

Shi Tianzhi sat on the chair, looked up at the ceiling, murmured, "Master Lord, I won't bother you in the troubles of the Chaos Realm, you have taken action. I just hope you can solve the troubles of the world as soon as possible and lead us. Reappearing the light.”

The drunk old man heard Shi Tianzhi's murmur, and his godless eyes suddenly became brighter.

"Yes, the city lord may just think it's a bit troublesome, but he didn't say that there must be no way."

"Damn, we can't be so decadent!"

"I'm about to come, and I suddenly feel a little itchy!"
